quest.title: Lost in Deep Seas
quest.description: You've been looking into the Fortress' "hidden rules" and seem to have obtained many leads on Childe. You are certain this trip will not be in vain.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x875, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: To the Stars Shining in the Depths

talks.objective: Get up and talk to Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so we've investigated two of the "hidden rules." Paimon didn't think this prison would have... so many weird things going on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd better pick up the pace with our investigation. Otherwise, we'll never get anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's spend some coupons to skip our shifts so we can go investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's skip work for now and put our time to good use!

dialogues.speaker: Vidoc
dialogues.text: Oho, seeing you at this time must mean you've already saved up a lot of Credit Coupons. Or at least enough to skip work... Heh, seems you're getting into the swing of things around here.

choices.text: We're getting by.

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: Impressive... Very impressive...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, now can you tell us about the hidden rules you know?

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: Ah, if that's what you what to know, I guess you couldn't have come at a better time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, what do you mean it's a good time?

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: Leonide and those other pesky broke urchins have all gone to work in the production zone. I wouldn't want them listening in without paying up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We get it, just tell us already!

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: So, you know those pipes that make strange sounds? Don't ever, ever go near them at night. Even if you manage to avoid the guards, you might find something even more terrible there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Something even more terrible? Like what?

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: A group of cannibals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cannibals!? In the Fortress of Meropide!?

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: Every month, they meet a few times in the dead of night. Rumor has it that they might be connected to the people that've disappeared here.

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: But what's even scarier is that they have a "special" proclivity...

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: Since they have no way to dispose of the leftover remains, they have ways to transform them into other forms and keep them in the Fortress forever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon might already know what you mean by "other forms"... So that's what's going on here. Ugh, Paimon's stomach doesn't feel so good...

choices.text: Is that really true?

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: Hehe, you two look pretty skeptical. No matter, learning the truth behind dark secrets isn't necessarily a good thing.

response.speaker: Vidoc
response.text: I've got things to do too. I suggest you just act like I never told you anything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, can we just trust him on this one? Oh, Paimon doesn't want her blood and flesh entombed here for all eternity...

choices.text: Even if it's true...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... So that's how you see the situation... Huh. Y'know, Paimon does feel a little better about it now.

choices.text: Alright, then just like before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* When will all the secrets end?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Brimming with curiosity, you and Paimon eat lunch and head out to investigate this new "hidden rule"...

choices.text: Let's get ready to investigate another hidden rule.
Do you really think cannibals could take me in a fight?
There's still a chance that what we saw isn't connected to cannibals.
My goal is to become the next Duke!

talks.objective: Ask the trio that hangs out together often

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: Just stay away from me.

talks.objective: Ask the trio that hangs out together often

dialogues.speaker: Leonide
dialogues.text: ...What are you talking about? Listen, you should keep your nose out of other people's business.

talks.objective: Ask the trio that hangs out together often

dialogues.speaker: Alexis
dialogues.text: What!? What are you saying!? You shouldn't go around saying stuff like that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so we've investigated two of the "hidden rules." Paimon didn't think this prison would have... so many weird things going on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd better pick up the pace with our investigation. Otherwise, we'll never get anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But I don't have enough Credit Coupons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? We already used up all our coupons?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, fine... Paimon secretly stashed some coupons away to buy some souvenirs and stuff, but it sounds like we really need them now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where did you get coupons?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Paimon's been working too, you know! Paimon just doesn't earn much, that's all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's use these coupons to get out of work so we have time to investigate!

talks.objective: Summarize the information you have collected

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Their attitude sure is suspicious, like they're trying to avoid us...

choices.text: It's pretty obvious that they're hiding something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if they're being so obvious about acting weirdly, do you think they might just be trying to lure us in?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is all getting way too creepy for Paimon...

choices.text: Let's approach it from a different angle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you mean we still need to investigate some more? Okay... If you say so...

choices.text: We'll probably never get anything out of these guys.
Could they be connected to the cannibals?

talks.objective: Ask the guard at the dormitories

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Fielding.

dialogues.speaker: Fielding
dialogues.text: Whaddaya want? Criminals like you oughta be working right now, catch my drift?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just want to ask you a simple question...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you ever discovered anything odd during your nighttime patrols?

dialogues.speaker: Fielding
dialogues.text: Why're you asking about something like that? Whatever happens at night isn't your concern. All you need to worry about is getting enough sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Well...

choices.text: You see, sometimes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Right, we've heard it happens a few times every month. Paimon has sensitive ears, so it makes it hard to sleep!

response.speaker: Fielding
response.text: Really? I see... but it's not like I'm on duty every night.

response.speaker: Fielding
response.text: Now that you mention it, I recall my colleagues talking about something like that before. They say that strange things tend to happen at night on pipe-cleaning days. Lots of us don't willingly take those shifts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what happens at night on pipe-cleaning days?

response.speaker: Fielding
response.text: They just conduct regular cleaning of the Fortress' drainage facilities.

response.speaker: Fielding
response.text: There are three pipe-cleaning days per month... And it just so happens that today is one of the scheduled days. You can try to confirm the sounds tonight if you want, and if they're real, then I can report the issue to my superiors for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, okay. Then we'll keep both ears out tonight!

response.speaker: Fielding
response.text: If that's all, then I'll be leaving now. I'd advise you not to try anything funny, though. Even if I'm not on duty tonight, someone will still be watching you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we don't want any time added to our sentences!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He left... So, what do you think about the pipe-cleaning days he mentioned?

choices.text: Those might be the days when the cannibals are active.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, both are a possibility. But Fielding did say that tonight is a cleaning night...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No reason not to find out the truth for ourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knew you would say that. Alright, sounds like we'll be up all night tonight then... Paimon just hopes the guards don't catch us.

choices.text: But it might also be nothing, just the pipes being cleaned.
We hear strange noises at night.

talks.objective: Return to the dormitories and rest until night

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *yawn* Paimon's so tired... But we can't sleep yet. They'll be cleaning the pipes tonight, so it's the perfect chance for us to investigate...

choices.text: We just need to wait until everyone else has fallen asleep...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever, just be sure to wake Paimon if she dozes off... Paimon's worried something might happen if you go alone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}? Did you fall asleep already!?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: "Something is calling me, I have to go."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! C'mon, wake up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! It looked like you were just peacefully sleeping to Paimon... Well, what did you see this time?

choices.text: Investigating the pipes tonight is the right call.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? So we're finally starting to figure out what actually happened... But what about the cannibals? How do you explain them?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm sure we'll find out soon enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay... Well, it's about time for us to get moving. Just be careful to avoid the patrolling guards.

choices.text: Childe escaped via the pipes.
I saw Childe in my dream again.
If we miss our chance tonight, it'll be a while before we get another opportunity.

talks.objective: Go to where the rumored pipes are
Go to where the rumored pipes are

dialogues.speaker: Leonide
dialogues.text: I know you... You were the ones we saw...

dialogues.speaker: Alexis
dialogues.text: Hmph, you've got guts showing up here. You know who we are, right?

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: You'd better leave now, ain't nobody coming here to save you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Enough with the theatrics...

dialogues.speaker: Alexis
dialogues.text: What you say!?

choices.text: All those rumors about cannibals and hidden rules...

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: Yeah, so what if they were? If you push us, we can make those rumors a reality at any time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What's the point of all those rumors anyway? What exactly are you trying to do?

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: I don't have to tell you anything. If you turn around, go back to the dormitories, and act like you never saw anything, then I'll pretend that you never showed up here!

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: Yeah, scram. Nothing worth seeing here...

choices.text: "There's something calling me..."

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: Huh...? What did you say?

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: Isn't that exactly what boss said when he left?

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: Hey, do you know our boss?

choices.text: Yeah, "Childe" Tartaglia?

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: Whoa, we had no idea our boss was such a big deal... he always kept his identity a secret.

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: So, did he have you come here to find us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so you're Childe's crew here? Seems like he had no problem fitting in...

choices.text: I'm a friend of his.

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: We're the only ones who heard him say those words when he left that night... So unless he somehow told you those exact same words after that...

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: Hmm... Alright, I guess that's proof enough for me. I believe you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, those dreams of yours sure come in handy.

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: We gave him the business for a while and would always give him a hard time when he first came to the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: But here in the Fortress, the strong will always earn respect.

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: He was working the longest hours and racking up wins in the Pankration Ring...

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: You could always see how amazing he was, even when he was teaching us a lesson...

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: So eventually, we all decided to follow him.

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: But one day, he suddenly told us that he had to find a way to escape this place, no matter the cost. He said it was because he heard that call again...

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: And as his crew, if the boss wants something, then it's our job to get it done.

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: So... We got to work and used the "hidden rules" that were here to make up and spread the rumor about the "cannibal rule"...

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: We just wanted to give him a better chance of escaping on a night after the pipes had been cleaned.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Thanks to your rumor, nobody would want to come anywhere near here, prisoner or guard! Wow, it sure is easy to exploit people's fear of the unknown.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But hasn't Childe already escaped? Why are you all still coming here after pipe-cleaning day?

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: Because as far as we know, the pipe he went into isn't actually an exit... It should be a dead end.

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: It leads to an abandoned factory area, and even if there were a way to escape from there into the sea, we're still way too deep. No-one could ever reach the surface alive.

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: But Boss still insisted on going in, it was like he was obsessed about it.

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: So we told him that we'd pretend as if he never existed while he was gone.

response.speaker: Poirier
response.text: And that if he wanted to come back, he should wait for nighttime on a pipe-cleaning day. That way, we could meet him here and help cover the whole thing up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you come and wait here through the night a few times a month just because of that promise?

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: Yeah, but it's been so long now, we already know in our hearts that he must have managed to escape somehow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, is it also possible that something... unfortunate happened to him?

response.speaker: Alexis
response.text: Nothing could ever defeat Boss or slow him down. That's one thing we know for sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay... Paimon was just brainstorming possibilities...

choices.text: Can you take us there...?

response.speaker: Leonide
response.text: Alright, keep quiet and follow us.

choices.text: We want to go to the spot where he left.
We came here to learn what happened to him.
One of Snezhnaya's Fatui Harbingers.
"I have to go."
Were started by you, weren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Fielding
dialogues.text: Using coupons to skip work doesn't bring freedom, but only pulls you closer to the abyss of degeneracy... That's what an old guard here used to say, you'd do well to remember it.

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: The way up from here has been sealed off. It's impossible to get through.

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: Boss left by going down from here. It wasn't full of water at the time...

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: Later, we came back hoping to have a look. That's when we found out it had been completely flooded.

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: It's impossible to navigate unless you're an extremely skilled diver.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think Childe got trapped by the water?

dialogues.speaker: Leonide
dialogues.text: Not likely, we all know that boss was an incredible swimmer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I know a good diver.

dialogues.speaker: Alexis
dialogues.text: Really? Then have him come investigate, pronto! Just be sure to tell us if you get any news about Boss.

dialogues.speaker: Poirier
dialogues.text: It's getting late. We should leave before the guards come this way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we learned a lot about what happened to Childe here. Let's get going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... We finally learned some key information. Seems all of our investigative work has finally started to pay off!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When you said you knew a diver, you were talking about Freminet, right? If we ask Lyney, he'll definitely have Freminet help us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! Why is Childe like this... What was he doing going into the pipes? Not making our jobs easier, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fortunately, though, it seems like it's only a matter of time now before we find out what really happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Now that we can finally relax, Paimon's starting to feel super sleepy. Let's try to get some rest while we still can. Nighty-night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay... Well, it's about time for us to get moving. Just be careful to avoid the patrolling guards.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, isn't that Vidoc over there? Huh, is it just Paimon, or are there fewer people than usual here today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, Vidoc isn't here, but the guys who went to work in the morning are back. Let's go ask them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, not this way! We need to get to that pipe, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shhh, careful! We'll get in trouble if the guards catch us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh! They spotted us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, this should be the place.
